name: theory-research-suite
description: Multi-agent theorem search and rigorous machine-learning paper writing workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Search for rigorous theory results and turn them into papers.
interface.longDescription: Provides two reusable workflows: a cyclic, independently audited multi-agent theory search and an evidence-aligned workflow for planning, drafting, revising, and reviewing machine-learning research papers.
defaultPrompt: Launch an audited multi-agent search for this theory problem.
Turn my proof notes into a rigorous theory-paper outline.
Review this manuscript for claim and evidence gaps.
